data.scan_interval: Scan interval for updates in seconds
data.scan_retries: Number of attempts for each data update
data.failure_cooldown: Seconds to wait after a failed update before logging in again (0 = off)
data.slow_scan_interval: Seconds between reads of everything except connected devices (reservations, leases, LED, ports...; 0 = every update)
data.hold_session: Stay logged in between updates (fewer logins; logging in to the router's web page pauses Home Assistant)
data.yield_minutes: Minutes to leave the router alone after another login takes over (held login only)
data.scan_pause: Minutes before data fetching re-enables automatically (0 = never)
data.offline_timeout: Seconds a missing device stays 'home' before going offline (0 = immediate)

data.support_vpn: Include support for VPN server and client
data.support_tracker: Include device trackers (disable for non-access-point routers to avoid duplicates)
data.tracker_as_device: Nest each tracked client under the router device (off by default; clients always get a device linked by MAC)
data.support_dhcp_reservations: Include DHCP reservations sensor and add/delete services
